title: Dark Matter and Dark Energy: What the Evidence Actually Says
description:
Dark matter and dark energy are different mysteries. This explainer separates gravitational evidence from particle identity, and expansion measurements from the unknown cause of acceleration. Diagrams are conceptual, not observational data.

0:00 Two mysteries, different jobs
1:04 Gravity reveals missing matter
2:11 Using light to map mass
3:17 Expansion is accelerating
4:20 What the surveys measure
5:22 Evidence is not a final identity
